chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad narrated from Ubayd Allah ibn Musa and Ahmad ibn Ali al-A'lam, who said: Muhammad ibn Ali as-Sayrafi narrated from Muhammad ibn Sadaqa, Ibn Othayna al-Abdi, and Muhammad ibn Sinan all together, from Ya'qub as-Sarraj, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:

Thirteen cities and tribes whose people Al-Qa'im will fight and who will fight him: the people of Mecca, the people of Medina, the people of Sham (Syria), the Umayyads, the people of Basra, the people of Dast Maysan, the Kurds, the Arab nomads, the tribe of Dhubban, Ghani, Bahila, Azd, and the people of Rayy.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الرَّيِّ: The people of Rayy (a city in Iran)
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: Al-Qa'im (The Riser), a title for the Twelfth Imam, Muhammad al-Mahdi

ai.seo_question: Which thirteen cities and tribes will fight Al-Qa'im according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* identifies thirteen specific urban centers and tribal confederations that will initially resist Al-Qa'im, reflecting the geopolitical tensions of the late Sasanian and early Islamic periods. The inclusion of Rayy and the Umayyads underscores the Shi'a perspective on the legacy of Sunni caliphates and regional powers, while the mention of tribes like Dhubyan and Ghani highlights the tribal dynamics of the Arabian Peninsula. This list serves as a eschatological roadmap for the initial military and political challenges the Mahdi will face before establishing global justice.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (6) Ali bin Ahmad bin Obaydillah bin Musa and Ahmad bin Ali al-A’lam narrated from Muhammad bin Ali as-Sayrafi from Muhammad bin Sadaqa, ibn Othayna al-Abdi and Muhammad bin Sinan from Ya’qoob as-Sarraj that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said: “

Al-Qa’im will fight the people of thirteen cities and nations and they will fight him; Mecca, Medina, Basra, Dast Maysan, Sham, the Umayyads, the Kurds, the Arab nomads, the people of the tribes of Dhabba, Ghaniy, Bahila, Azd and the people of ar-Riy (a town in Iran).”
